blockers.title: The post-D-044 MF-8 MEASURED regeneration never occurred

evidence.mf8Rule: D-001 defines DR-001 route A as two stages: regenerate both manifests at HEAD and record MEASURED, then perform the SATISFIED re-record only after independent review.
evidence.d044Rule: D-044 clause 3 requires 'MEASURED regeneration now; SATISFIED only after independent review'; clause 4 says the manifests remain as-is only until a later MEASURED regeneration and expressly says D-044 is not that regeneration.
evidence.manifestLastMeasurement: Both manifests identify C-D014 on 2026-08-13 as their latest measurement, at commit 423153874a98b6fe8a48974cf8ac3b01a3644f88.
evidence.chronology: D-044 was adopted later at afc0990; HEAD then advanced through D-045 and D-046 to cf1c956. No later MEASURED regeneration is recorded in either manifest or the adopted coordinator decisions.
evidence.subjectConflict: The proposed SATISFIED lead explicitly says 'Manifests not regenerated' and relies on the pre-D-044 C-D014 MEASURED pins. Rechecking 49/49 and 41/41 during this review proves byte equality but does not perform or record MF-8's required first-stage regeneration.

blockers.impact: The proposed file-08-only SATISFIED act skips the first stage D-044 expressly preserved. Independent review cannot convert an unrecorded regeneration into the required prior MEASURED state, so the re-record is not yet lawful.
blockers.requiredRepair: In a separate pre-SATISFIED act, regenerate both manifests at the intended terminal HEAD and record that state as MEASURED under MF-8. Then dispatch a fresh independent SATISFIED-grade review against the resulting frozen bytes.

turn1FindingVerification.evidence: The proposed lead makes the two zero-SATISFIED accounting sentences and the later LIVE-OPEN clause historical, states the new one-of-eleven accounting, and does not claim condition 1 discharged.

R6 records the exact blueprint CLAIMS digest 95097b3f..., the live/baseline digest 767dc210..., the Section 1.1 stop rule, the authoritative live binding, and the pending blueprint-successor boundary. It is no longer presented as no-conflict.
The sweep denominator is correctly restated as 15 bindings: 9 digest-pinned and 6 name-only.

gradeRationale: The turn-1 findings are now represented correctly, and every substantive byte/selector/execution check is green. The grade nevertheless fails on ordering and provenance: D-044 requires a new MEASURED manifest-regeneration stage after its re-open, while the proposed lead expressly skips regeneration and relies on C-D014, which predates D-044. A green independent recheck is not the missing recorded first stage.
